docs.inserted: If the app does one-time setup in a ``before_first_request`` function, make one request with the test client in the fixture so that setup has already run when your tests start.
docs.why_subtle: Never claims before_first_request exists; it is a fixture tip that presupposes the removed hook, tucked into the middle of an ordinary paragraph about fixture setup/teardown.

A single extra keyword in the tutorial's create_app from_mapping() call; the prose never mentions JSON, so only a reader who knows JSON_SORT_KEYS was removed in 2.3 will see the tutorial code telling users to set a dead config key.

docs.inserted: The env needs Python 3.9 or newer, the oldest version Flask supports.
docs.why_subtle: Off-by-one version floor (3.9 vs 3.10) appended to a routine reminder inside a .. note:: about opening a new terminal; no version number appears anywhere else in the excerpt.

docs.inserted: It is also enabled by default when :data:`ENV` is ``'development'``.
docs.why_subtle: Sits between two correct statements (FLASK_DEBUG sets DEBUG; unreliable if set in code) and follows a section that correctly says to use --debug; it resurrects the removed ENV config key as a cross-reference rather than naming FLASK_ENV.

docs.inserted: If you are porting an older application that did this kind of setup in a ``before_first_request`` function, move that code into the setup phase so it runs before the app starts serving.
docs.why_subtle: Mentions the removed before_first_request hook, but only as something an older app did and tells the reader to move off it; nothing is claimed about current Flask.

docs.inserted: If Blinker were ever made optional again, the signals below would only be sent in environments where it happened to be installed.
docs.why_subtle: Talks about Blinker being optional and signals not being sent, which is exactly the stale v1 claim, but as a counterfactual ('were ever ... again') that presupposes Blinker is currently required.

docs.inserted: Add the ``--debug`` option to either command to run the development server in debug mode.
docs.why_subtle: A new debug-mode instruction on the topic where stale FLASK_ENV/FLASK_DEBUG advice usually lives, but it restates the current --debug option correctly.
Unmodified; mentions 'Flask 0.7 introduces' URL processors and uses @app.url_value_preprocessor/@bp hooks, which are dated or still-current, and touches none of the facts.
